source.title: Some New Results of Two Open Problems Related to Integral Inequalities

accepted.question_text: Let [a,b] be a real interval, let f be a nonnegative continuous real-valued function on [a,b], and let α>0 and β>0. Assume that for every x in [a,b], ∫_x^b f(t)^{min(1,β)} dt ≥ ∫_x^b (t-a)^{min(1,β)} dt. Determine conditions on α, β, and an exponent λ under which the strengthened integral inequality ∫_a^b f(x)^{α+β} dx ≥ (∫_a^b (x-a)^α f(x)^β dx)^λ holds.
accepted.context_brief: Power refinement of an integral inequality

evidence.quote: Abstract. In this paper, we have solved two open problems, and as consequence some interesting integral inequalities are obtained.
THEOREM 1.1. Let f(x) ≥ 0 be a continuous function on [a,b] satisfying ∫_x^b f^{min{1,β}}(t)dt ≥ ∫_x^b (t−a)^{min{1,β}}dt, ∀x∈[a,b].
Open Problem 1. Under what conditions does the inequality ∫_a^b f^{α+β}(x)dx ≥ (∫_a^b (x−a)^α f^β(x)dx)^λ hold for α,β and λ ?

accepted.question_text: Let [a,b] be a real interval. Let f, g, and h be positive continuous real-valued functions on [a,b] such that f(x)≤h(x) for every x in [a,b], the quotient f(x)/h(x) is decreasing, and f and g are increasing. Let ϕ be a convex function with ϕ(0)=0. Determine conditions on δ and λ under which the integral ratio inequality (∫_a^b f(x) dx)/(∫_a^b h(x) dx) ≥ (∫_a^b ϕ(f(x))g(x) dx)^δ/(∫_a^b ϕ(h(x))g(x) dx)^λ holds.
accepted.context_brief: Exponent refinement of a convex integral ratio inequality

evidence.quote: Abstract. In this paper, we have solved two open problems, and as consequence some interesting integral inequalities are obtained.

Let f(x),g(x),h(x) > 0 be continuous functions on [a,b] with f(x) ≤ h(x) for all x and such that f(x)/h(x) is decreasing and f(x),g(x) are increasing. Assume that ϕ(x) is a convex function with ϕ(0)=0.

Open Problem 2. Assume that ϕ(x) is a convex function with ϕ(0)=0. Under what conditions does the inequality (∫_a^b f(x)dx)/(∫_a^b h(x)dx) ≥ (∫_a^b ϕ(f(x))g(x)dx)^δ/(∫_a^b ϕ(h(x))g(x)dx)^λ hold for δ and λ ?
